description:
What a graph's look can set (see "Theme Studio" in get_guide): the themes, card materials and
        control families, and every value with its type and range. Filter by surface (Application,
        Node editor canvas, Nodes, Connections, Dashboard, Cards, Widgets) or group (Colors, Background, Edges,
        Glow, Shadows).
        Example: describe_theme_values(surface="Cards", group="Glow").

group.description: Only values of this group: Colors, Background, Edges, Glow or Shadows. Empty for all.
group.title: Group

surface.description: Only values of this surface: Application, Node editor canvas, Nodes, Connections, Dashboard, Cards or Widgets. Empty for all.
surface.title: Surface

name: describe_theme_values
title: Describe the Theme Studio values
